_meta.note: Benchmark-specific launch configurations. Select one benchmark section and render placeholders with dataset/render_config.py. Copy only launch_config to the local mcpServers object under main_pool_name; null means add a new entry under the override key. Omit null cwd values. Keep other selected entries unchanged. Benchmark runners may instead require the override keys as aliases. install records setup commands; source records pinned upstream revisions where available. Supply required values through your local dataset/.env file.

NixOS.note: Uses mcp-nixos 1.0.0 for the benchmark's darwin_* and home_manager_* tools. The setup command and launch configuration use the same pinned version.

Reddit.install: git clone https://github.com/Accenture/mcp-bench.git && cd mcp-bench && git checkout 7a8eaeae83a842a2949080acc5473f65e1569daf && cd mcp_servers && bash install.sh
Reddit.note: Uses mcp_servers/mcp-reddit from the pinned mcp-bench checkout. Run its mcp_servers/install.sh to install the Python dependencies before launching.

notion.note: Uses the official @notionhq/notion-mcp-server package at version 1.8.1 for the benchmark's API-* tools.

github.note: Uses the official GitHub MCP server 0.5.0 Docker image. Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your local environment file.

playwright.note: Uses @playwright/mcp 0.0.30 in headless, isolated mode. Install Chromium separately before the first launch.

weather-data.note: Install from the pinned source commit and launch the weather_mcp_server.main Python module.

notion.note: Uses the official @notionhq/notion-mcp-server package at version 1.8.1, matching the MCP-Universe override.

twelvedata.note: Uses mcp-server-twelve-data 0.2.5. Supply TWELVEDATA_API_KEY for the -k argument.

clinicaltrialsgov-mcp-server.note: Uses clinicaltrialsgov-mcp-server 1.0.8; this configuration requires no credentials.

cli-mcp-server.note: This entry is not in the main pool. Uses cli-mcp-server 0.2.5 with ALLOWED_DIR restricted to services/agent-environment/data in the mcp-atlas checkout.

github.note: Uses the geobio/smitheryai-mcp-servers-github implementation at the pinned commit. This differs from the official GitHub server used by the MCP-Universe override.
